lastCompletedStory.title: Tear down plan panes at a single unconditional exit in runPlanPhaseWithReplan

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-269/CAM-167) closed the last gap in runPlanPhaseWithReplan's teardown coverage: teardownPlanPanesFn now fires exactly once via a single try/finally wrapping the whole function body, covering every PlanPhaseResult terminal kind (audit-approved, plan-escalated, planner-timeout, auditor-timeout, planner-failed, preflight-failed, no-plannable-issue, plan-target-invalid, mutex-busy, container-preflight-failed). The CAM-204 round-boundary teardown() call inside the re-plan while loop (mid-function, not an exit) is unchanged. Existing tests that previously asserted 'teardown NOT called' for non-audit/pre-spawn kinds were flipped to 'called exactly once' (plan-runner-replan.test.ts, plan-runner-target-invalid.test.ts), and 3 new tests cover planner-timeout/auditor-timeout/planner-failed exactly-once teardown. sidecar.ts wiring (makeTeardownPlanPanesFn) was untouched -- the seam signature did not change. src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts's file-size ceiling was raised 1362->1381 in scripts/file-size-budget.json (staged with the tracker-ref commit). No other stories are queued in this PRD as of this handoff; if more exist, check scripts/cam/prd.json for the next passes:false entry.
